summary: One more source-decided check with real safety weight, found in the neighbourhood of the handler I had been working in: the leader verification counts acknowledgements from a strictly larger set than the set its target is computed over, and nothing between them filters by suffrage. verifyLeader starts its count at one for the leader and sets the target to quorumSize, which counts voters only, then registers the verification on every entry of the leader's replication state - and that state has one entry per member of the latest configuration except the node itself, because startStopReplication creates entries for every server and skips only the local node, so non-voting members are replicated to and heartbeated like voters. When a heartbeat is acknowledged, notifyAll hands the ack to every registered verification and vote increments the count without asking what suffrage that member holds. With a three-voter configuration plus non-voters, the leader's own vote plus one acknowledgement from a non-voter reaches a target of two while both other voters may be unreachable. That matters because verification is the guard the documentation offers against serving stale data after losing leadership, so a caller that verifies before reading can be told the node is still leader under exactly the condition the guard exists to detect. I recorded it with both paths cited and stated the scope honestly: elections are unaffected because electSelf asks voters only, commitment is unaffected because it counts voter match indexes, and the leader-lease check counts voters only and steps such a leader down within the lease interval, so the exposure is a bounded window rather than an indefinite false positive, and the countermeasure the verification lacks already exists one function away. Four counterweights and three limits are recorded, including that this is a code-structure claim with no execution behind it and that it needs a topology with reachable non-voters and an unreachable voter majority. The rest of the run's record is unchanged: six witnessed behaviours including the durable term regression with its reproduction and causal control and the protocol-gate bypass on the heartbeat fast path, the conditional account of when the regression can arise with the registered question about asymmetric write latencies, two uninstrumented probes bounding its natural rate at zero falls in 792 and 768 deliveries, the scoped log-cache negative, and the two knowledge corrections.
